sceneCreate.content1: Fog rolled over the stone steps of the harbor wall. Wren Hale stood at the edge and watched the tide pull away from the moorings.
sceneCreate.content2: The brass key was worn smooth, but the scratch across its bow looked new. Wren reached for it. Before her fingers touched it, Ada closed her hand.

ai.input: Read the project files, then continue this chapter
ai.response: I have loaded the current chapter and related project files.
ai.desc: The current file, outline, character sheets, and world notes are available in this conversation.

sceneSuggest.content1: Fog rolled over the stone steps of the harbor wall. Wren Hale stood at the edge and watched the tide pull away from the moorings.
sceneSuggest.content2: Three winters earlier, the harbor board had struck her name from the pilots' roll. She had not set foot on the quay since.
sceneSuggest.content3: Footsteps sounded behind her. Ada stepped out of the fog and set a brass key stamped with the old Hale crest in front of her.

ai.input: Continue with Ada bringing a new clue
ai.response: I will continue from the current chapter and character context.
ai.desc: The continuation is written directly to the current chapter.

sceneEdit.originalText: Ada came out of the fog and handed the brass key to Wren.
sceneEdit.suggestionText: Ada stepped out of the fog and set a brass key stamped with the old Hale crest in front of her.

ai.response: I rewrote the paragraph using the current chapter.
ai.desc: Accept to save a new version, or return to the version before this edit.
